name: pino-child-logger-debug-type-narrowing
hook: Pino child logger debug() only accepts (obj, message?) not (message, args)
body:
When using `logger.child({...})`, the resulting child logger's `debug` method has narrowed type signature: it only accepts `(obj: object, message?: string)`, NOT `(message: string, ...args)`. 

**Wrong:** `childLogger.debug('message string', params)` — TypeScript error S2769
**Correct:** `childLogger.debug({ ...params, detail: 'message' })`

This is because the child logger's type already includes the bindings as the implicit first argument context, so the first explicit arg must be an object (to merge with bindings).
why: Encountered this during issue #2103 when fetchLessonContext's log.debug call failed typecheck with S2769. The error message was misleading - it said 'No overload matches this call' which doesn't clearly indicate the child logger type narrowing issue.
